text:
A pipe full of water connects a water supply on a hill to a tap lower down the hill.
The length of the pipe is 500m. The height of the supply above the tap is 100m.
The density of the water is 1000kg/m3. The effect of atmospheric pressure is negligible.
What is the water pressure at the tap?
A
100000Pa
B
500000Pa
C
1000000Pa
D
5000000Pa
subject: Physics
